fixes.fix: Cache.__setitem__ over-evicts unrelated items when an existing key grows (old size of the key was double-counted)
fixes.why: Growing b from 2 to 7 in a maxsize-10 cache evicted a although 2+7 fits, i.e. needless data loss.
fixes.upstream_commit: 39b31bc Fix #405: Fix Cache.__setitem__ over-evicting when growing an existing key

fixes.fix: TLRUCache.__setitem__ with an already-expired value left the previous value in place
fixes.why: cache[k] = v silently kept returning the old value, violating mapping semantics.
fixes.upstream_commit: c0fdf6a Fix TLRUCache silently keeping stale value on expired overwrite (merged as fcbb0de Fix #406)

fixes.fix: super()/explicit-base access to a @cachedmethod stored the base wrapper in the instance dict, shadowing the subclass override
fixes.why: After one super().get() call, obj.get dispatched to the base method forever, skipping the override (wrong results).
fixes.upstream_commit: ec0b97b Fix #437: Preserve cachedmethod super dispatch and expand inheritance coverage

fixes.fix: Calling a @cachedmethod through the class (Base.method(obj, ...), Base.method.cache_clear(obj)) failed
fixes.why: Class.method(obj, x) raised AttributeError on None, breaking the normal unbound-call idiom.
fixes.upstream_commit: aa73a19 Fix #435: Restore class access to cached instance methods; later 95e6add Fix #443: Restore autospec calls

fixes.fix: Instances could not be pickled/deep-copied after a cached method was called (local Wrapper class stored in __dict__); added Wrapper.__reduce__ rebinding to the new instance
fixes.why: pickle.dumps(obj) raised 'Can't get local object ...Wrapper' merely because obj.get() had been called.

fixes.fix: copy.copy(obj) carried over a wrapper bound to the original instance, so the clone's cached method used the original's self/cache; made the descriptor a data descriptor that detects and replaces stale wrappers (with __set__/__delete__ to keep assignment/mock.patch working)
fixes.why: clone.get(1) returned the original object's result and wrote into the original's cache.
